sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United have an impressive week ahead with two fixtures. First, they travel to face Stockport County in the Cheshire Senior Cup on Tuesday 13 October (a cup tie against opponents from a different tier), before returning to league action at home against Bilston Town on Saturday 17 October at 15:00. Sandbach sit atop the table with 28 points from 12 games and have won their last five league matches, so they'll be looking to maintain that impressive form against third-placed Bilston, who are also in exceptional form with four consecutive league wins.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town, currently four points behind Sandbach with 24 points, face Brereton Social away on Saturday as they look to keep pace with the leaders. In the midfield battle, fifth-placed Barnton host AFC Bridgnorth (sixth, 20 points) on Saturday—a direct clash between sides in strong recent form. Third-placed Bilston Town have a midweek fixture against Dawley Town on Wednesday before their league match against Sandbach. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain struggling Telford Town (7 points) on Saturday and should be favoured to extend their push up the table. On Tuesday evening, AFC Bridgnorth visit Market Drayton Town, Foley Meir are at home to Cheadle Heath Nomads, and Crewe host Widnes Town in midweek action. Saturday also sees Eccleshall (19 points) host Crewe (9 points), a fixture that favours the visitors' opponents on current form. Allscott Heath welcome mid-table Foley Meir on Saturday, while Shawbury United face Cheadle Heath Nomads at home—a meeting between 13th and 16th respectively. Wednesfield Community entertain Market Drayton Town on Saturday in a clash between struggling sides, and New Mills visit Alsager Town (in alarming form with six consecutive league losses) on Saturday.
